subject: AS A RESPONSE MEASURE TO THE PROHIBITION BY THE AUTHORITIES OF
text:
U1507/26 NOTAMR U1048/26
Q)UUWV/QOAXX/IV/BO/A/000/999/5535N03716E999
A)UUUU B)2611111430 C)2702112359 EST
E)AS A RESPONSE MEASURE TO THE PROHIBITION BY THE AUTHORITIES OF
NORTH MACEDONIA STIPULATING THAT ALL ACFT REGISTERED, OWNED,
CHARTERED OR OPERATED BY NATURAL PERSONS OR LEGAL ENTITIES OF THE
RUSSIAN FEDERATION OR OPERATORS HOLDING AIR OPERATOR CERTIFICATE
(AOC) ISSUED BY THE AUTHORITIES OF THE RUSSIAN FEDERATION ARE
PROHIBITED TO ENTER, EXIT OR OVERFLY THE AIRSPACE OF THE REPUBLIC
OF NORTH MACEDONIA, AS PER NOTAM A1265/26,
THE AVIATION AUTHORITIES OF THE RUSSIAN FEDERATION HEREBY INFORM
THAT ALL ACFT REGISTERED, OWNED, CHARTERED OR OPERATED BY NATURAL
PERSONS OR LEGAL ENTITIES FROM NORTH MACEDONIA OR BY OPERATORS
HOLDING AOC ISSUED BY THE NORTH MACEDONIAN AUTHORITIES ARE
PROHIBITED TO ENTER, EXIT OR OVERFLY THE AIRSPACE OF THE RUSSIAN
FEDERATION EXC FOR HUMANITARIAN FLIGHTS, SAR FLIGHTS, EMERGENCY LDG
OR EMERGENCY OVERFLIGHT AS WELL AS IN CASES WHEN A SPECIAL
PERMISSION FOR FLIGHT OPERATIONS IS GRANTED BY THE FEDERAL AIR
TRANSPORT AGENCY OR THE MINISTRY OF FOREIGN AFFAIRS OF THE RUSSIAN
FEDERATION, AS APPROPRIATE.
